name: Sarah Elfreth
stance: Ties the FAA case to the broader need to regulate AI safety before it is deployed in critical systems.

statements.text: Co-led the letter urging the FAA to pause its AI-enabled air-traffic tool pending safety testing and oversight answers.
As AI safety concerns are top of mind for our neighbors, this is another instance where we cannot afford to miss the moment on regulating this technology.
